name: Viewshed Fields (VF) Learning
aliases: Viewshed Fields (VF) with Normalizing Flows (NF) Integration
definition: The process of learning the VF representation using Normalizing Flows to map oriented points to a Gaussian distribution.
summary: Viewshed Fields Learning uses Normalizing Flows to model viewpoint likelihoods, enabling generative sampling of geometrically consistent camera poses for NeRF registration.
